title: Havells Borewell V4 HC4W18B15S Residential Submersible Pump 1.1kW
description: Product DescriptionHavells borewell v4 hc4w18b15s residential submersible pump of 0.75 kw comes with a energy efficient motor that works even at a higher temperature.
